name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
knownWorkarounds: Use DXMT as the default DirectX 11 backend; DXMT v0.73 fixed Ori's historical missing-character rendering bug.
Apply Steam Chromium locale and sandbox compatibility environment inherited from the maintained Whisky launcher presets.
Use extended WinHTTP timeouts for large Steam downloads.
Keep Ori in the dedicated prefix; do not reuse the native macOS Steam installation.
Use windowed or borderless mode if a runtime-specific fullscreen focus bug appears.
